d: The F&B Attendant is responsible for delivering exceptional food and beverage service to guests at Le Petit Belge, ensuring a welcoming, engaging, and memorable dining experience in accordance with Crowne Plaza brand standards and the hotel's service expectations.
q: li
High school diploma or equivalent qualification.
li
Previous experience in Food & Beverage service, preferably in a hotel, restaurant, or casual dining establishment.
li
Experience in an international hotel brand or themed restaurant is an advantage.
li
Basic knowledge of food and beverage service techniques.
li
Knowledge of restaurant hygiene, food safety, and sanitation practices.
li
Good command of English; Arab languages are an advantage.
li
Knowledge or interest in Belgian cuisine and European dining concepts is desirable.

r: li
Welcome and acknowledge guests promptly with a warm, friendly, and professional approach.
li
Escort guests to their tables and assist with seating arrangements when required.
li
Present menus, explain food and beverage selections, and provide recommendations based on guests' preferences.
li
Demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of the restaurant's menu, Belgian specialties, beverages, promotions, and daily offers.
li
Take food and beverage orders accurately and communicate special requests, dietary requirements, and allergies to the kitchen team.
li
Serve food and beverages promptly, following established service sequences and presentation standards.
li
Regularly check guest satisfaction throughout the dining experience and anticipate their needs.
li
Handle guest inquiries, feedback, and complaints professionally, escalating concerns to the supervisor when necessary.
li
Present bills accurately and process payments in accordance with hotel procedures.
li
Thank guests sincerely and encourage them to return to Le Petit Belge.
